notes.title: Update Announcement - December 21, 2023
notes.content:
We have received numerous error reports from players, and after a period of investigation, we have found that this issue is quite widespread and urgently needs to be addressed. As a result, we have released a new update and have been testing it over the past few weeks. We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the issue and hope that the new update will resolve your troubles.

Update details:

1. Improved stability of in-game saves.
2. Added new automatic repair logic.
If your save data is still intact, the game will automatically repair it; if there is missing save data, the game will prompt for a restart and create a new save file.

notes.title: Russian Version Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508655/98d5a49695cd205ba566ecf22e343e48b8fe2e0f.jpg[/img]
We are very happy to tell you our game supporting Russian language now! Hope you guys love it!
If you already running the game in another language, or your system language is not Russian, just follow the steps below:
    1. Right-click the game title in your library, select Properties...
    2. Switch to "LANGUAGE" page, select Russian language
    3. Restart the game
    4. Enjoy!

notes.title: About Language Settings
notes.content:
This is a copy from Steam Support:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The language of many games can be changed independently from the Steam client language.

1. Log into your Steam account
2. Right click on a game from the Steam game library and choose Properties.
3. Go to the Language tab
4. Select the language you wish to use from the drop-down menu
5. Click OK
If the game supports the language you have selected, files for that language may need to be downloaded before you can play.
 

If you are experiencing problems enabling a language, make sure your desired language is selected in both locations.

Note: Some languages may not be available for the game you wish to play. Check the Steam store page for the game to see which languages are offered.

[b]Make sure your computer system have installed .NET Framework 4.6.2[/b]

[h1]About Too Fast Game Speed[/h1]
If you set V-Sync as open, the game speed will sync to the freq of your monitor. There are two methods to resolve it : 
(1) Reset the freq of your monitor as 60Hz
(2) Disable V-Sync
